evidence_slice: MHCLG Planning Data entity 560009 records the Ebbsfleet Development Corporation boundary and links it to The Ebbsfleet Development Corporation (Area and Constitution) Order 2015, with point POINT (0.310446 51.446354). The Planning Data development-corporation-boundary dataset is licensed under Open Government Licence v3.0 and reports a collector run on 2026-09-01. The 2014 government Ebbsfleet development consultation describes the development corporation/garden-city programme as capable of providing up to 15,000 new homes, while 2026 regulations continue to recognise the Ebbsfleet Development Corporation and its development area.
